_about: Level 4 floor plan: a made-up layout for the demo. Coordinates are SVG units in a 1000 x 560 box. To match a real building, redraw the rectangles here; nothing else needs to change. rooms: keyed by room_id from the sensors; name = what the room is called when ROOM_NAMES has no entry for it (shown as written in both languages); door = gap in the corridor wall; exit = nearest stairwell, also used by the chat's 'check first' answer. Rooms that report data but are not listed here still show as cards, just not on the plan. other: spaces without a sensor, drawn for orientation only. link (optional): where the room's CSI sender and receiver stand, for the sensing line on the overview. Labels are keys in strings.json.
